headline: Taxi drivers' despair over the rise in gasoline prices: they spend more than 2,000 euros a month
summary: Taxi drivers in Spain report that rising gasoline prices are pushing their monthly costs above 2,000 euros. Users are increasingly angry over fuel prices during what is described as the second worst summer in history.
why: Gasoline prices reflect crude oil costs and refining margins, and they feed into transport costs and household inflation.
